svg.title: Why not just Claude or Codex?
svg.desc: Your researcher runs on Claude, Codex and the others, and adds what a plain assistant does not keep. Your library: a plain assistant forgets what it read; your researcher turns what you read into notes on your computer, and its answers cite them and say what is missing. You: a plain assistant starts over in every chat; your researcher keeps your questions, your voice and your rules in your own files. Portability: switch assistant or computer and you start over; your researcher installs on Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor or Antigravity, another account or computer, and keeps everything, with a private copy on GitHub. KaxaNuk's knowledge: a plain assistant knows what anyone knows; your researcher carries skills for the eight-step process and every Lab library, with their traps. Your own skills: a plain assistant only brings its own; your researcher creates the skills you need with the same architecture, in its folder, and they travel with it. For research and learning, never advice; what it reads goes to your assistant's company, never to KaxaNuk.
